name: Renal AL amyloidosis
value: 56-year-old woman followed for an M protein on serum electrophoresis, with free light chains in her urine: 2 months of frothy urine and ankle swelling. BP 128/78. UA 4+ protein, no blood. 24-h protein 9 g, albumin 2.0 g/dL.

name: Renal AL amyloidosis
value: Older adult with an M protein in serum and free light chains in urine; plasma-cell clone, lambda more often than kappa; new nephrotic syndrome

name: Granulomatosis with polyangiitis
value: 45-year-old woman with 4 months of recurrent sinusitis, bloody nasal crusts and nosebleeds, now coughing blood. Perforated nasal septum. BP 150/92. UA RBC casts, 1+ protein. Creatinine 2.6 mg/dL. No asthma; eosinophils normal.

name: Granulomatosis with polyangiitis
value: Childhood to middle age; PR3 (cytoplasmic) ANCA; recurrent sinusitis, epistaxis and nasal septal ulcers or perforation, hemoptysis, lung infarcts

name: Thin basement membrane disease
value: No treatment needed: reassure the family that renal function usually stays normal, the outlook is excellent and progression to renal failure is not expected

name: Thin basement membrane disease
value: Normal on light microscopy: glomeruli, tubules and interstitium unremarkable, with no extra cells

name: Lupus nephritis, class V
value: Many subepithelial electron-dense deposits spread evenly along the whole outer surface of the GBM
